answer:
I built the workout tracker on the "Workouts" note's App side, and `check_app` passes with no issues. I only ran the automated checks. I didn't look at screenshots or try logging a set myself.

- **Today:** It shows today's session, or the next one coming up, and how many exercises you've logged. Tap an exercise to log sets, reps and weight. The sheet is prefilled from your last time, and there's a short list of your latest sets underneath.
- **Progress:** It shows sessions in the last 7 days against your weekly goal, your best and latest weight per exercise, a weight-over-time chart and recent sets.
- **Plan:** It lists your weekly sessions. To edit them, switch to the Text side.
- **Settings:** The gear icon opens a screen for kg or lb and the weekly goal. Weights are always stored in kg, and the lb setting only changes how they're shown. The weight field in the log sheet is labelled "kg" either way.

Your data is two tables in the note, so you can read and edit it on the Text side:

- **Plan:** I filled it with a starter split: Mon Push, Wed Pull, Fri Legs. Change it to whatever you do.
- **Log:** It has one example row I made up (Bench Press, 2026-09-28, 3 × 8 at 57.5 kg), so the Progress screen has something to show. Delete it if you don't want it.

A note can have an app: one HTML document shown on the note's App side, next to its Text side. A habit grid, a budget with totals, flashcards, a trip planner. {"example":"training","files":{"/README.md":"# Training

Strength training over the note's Plan and Log tables.

- `src/App.jsx`: the screens (Today, Plan, Progress) in an amber-ui Shell, plus Settings.
- `src/data.js`: small helpers. The note's tables come from `useTable("Plan")` and `useTable("Log")` (from "amber"); logging a set is `log.add({...})`.
- `src/screens/`: one file per screen. `src/components/`: pieces used by several screens.
- Settings (units, weekly goal) are kept with useSettings, in the app's own data, not the note.
